<script>
(function() {
  'use strict';

  // ── HEADER SCROLL STATE ───────────────────
  const header = document.getElementById('header');
  let scrollTicking = false;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
    if (!scrollTicking) {
      requestAnimationFrame(function() {
        header.classList.toggle('header--scrolled', window.scrollY > 10);
        scrollTicking = false;
      });
      scrollTicking = true;
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  // ── MOBILE MENU ───────────────────────────
  var menuToggle = document.getElementById('menuToggle');
  var mainNav = document.getElementById('mainNav');
  var navLinks = mainNav.querySelectorAll('.header__nav-link');

  menuToggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
    var isOpen = mainNav.classList.toggle('header__nav--open');
    menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
  });

  navLinks.forEach(function(link) {
    link.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mainNav.classList.remove('header__nav--open');
      menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    });
  });

  // Close mobile menu on outside click
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (!header.contains(e.target) && mainNav.classList.contains('header__nav--open')) {
      mainNav.classList.remove('header__nav--open');
      menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    }
  });

  // ── FEATURED PRODUCTS CAROUSEL ────────────
  var track = document.getElementById('featuredTrack');
  var prevBtn = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
  var nextBtn = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
  var scrollAmount = 280; // card width + gap

  function updateArrows() {
    var tolerance = 4;
    var atStart = track.scrollLeft <= tolerance;
    var atEnd = track.scrollLeft + track.clientWidth >= track.scrollWidth - tolerance;
    prevBtn.disabled = atStart;
    nextBtn.disabled = atEnd;
  }

  prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    track.scrollBy({ left: -scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    track.scrollBy({ left: scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  track.addEventListener('scroll', updateArrows, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', updateArrows, { passive: true });
  updateArrows();

  // Keyboard navigation for carousel
  track.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
      e.preventDefault();
      track.scrollBy({ left: -scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
      e.preventDefault();
      track.scrollBy({ left: scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  });

  // ── STORE LOCATOR ─────────────────────────
  var locatorForm = document.getElementById('locatorForm');
  var locatorResults = document.getElementById('locatorResults');
  var locatorEmpty = document.getElementById('locatorEmpty');
  var zipInput = document.getElementById('zipInput');

  locatorForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var zip = zipInput.value.trim();

    // Hide previous state
    locatorResults.classList.remove('locator__results--visible');
    locatorEmpty.classList.remove('locator__empty--visible');

    if (!zip || !/^\d{5}$/.test(zip)) {
      locatorEmpty.textContent = 'Please enter a valid 5-digit zip code.';
      locatorEmpty.classList.add('locator__empty--visible');
      zipInput.focus();
      return;
    }

    // Simulate network delay then show results
    var btn = document.getElementById('locatorBtn');
    var originalText = btn.textContent;
    btn.textContent = 'Searching...';
    btn.disabled = true;

    setTimeout(function() {
      btn.textContent = originalText;
      btn.disabled = false;
      locatorResults.classList.add('locator__results--visible');
      locatorResults.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
    }, 500);
  });

  // ── NEWSLETTER ────────────────────────────
  var newsletterForm = document.getElementById('newsletterForm');
  var newsletterConfirm = document.getElementById('newsletterConfirm');
  var emailInput = document.getElementById('emailInput');

  newsletterForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var email = emailInput.value.trim();

    if (!email || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
      emailInput.focus();
      return;
    }

    newsletterConfirm.classList.add('newsletter__confirmation--visible');
    newsletterForm.reset();
  });

  // ── SMOOTH SCROLL FOR ANCHOR LINKS ────────
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(function(anchor) {
    anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      var target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
      if (target) {

img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }

a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }

button { cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; border: none; background: none; }

ul { list-style: none; }

.container { max-width: var(--max-width); margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }

.section { padding: 80px 0; }

.section--cream { background-color: var(--color-bg-dark); }

.header {

.header--scrolled { box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }

.header__logo-icon {

/* ── FEATURED PRODUCTS CAROUSEL ────────────── */
.featured__header {

.highlights {

.seasonal-card__desc {

.seasonal-card__price {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);

/* ── CATEGORIES ────────────────────────────── */
.categories__grid {

.locator__form {

.footer__heading {

.footer__links { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }

<script>
(function() {
  'use strict';

  // ── HEADER SCROLL STATE ───────────────────
  const header = document.getElementById('header');
  let scrollTicking = false;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
    if (!scrollTicking) {
      requestAnimationFrame(function() {
        header.classList.toggle('header--scrolled', window.scrollY > 10);
        scrollTicking = false;
      });
      scrollTicking = true;
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  // ── MOBILE MENU ───────────────────────────
  var menuToggle = document.getElementById('menuToggle');
  var mainNav = document.getElementById('mainNav');
  var navLinks = mainNav.querySelectorAll('.header__nav-link');

  menuToggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
    var isOpen = mainNav.classList.toggle('header__nav--open');
    menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
  });

  navLinks.forEach(function(link) {
    link.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mainNav.classList.remove('header__nav--open');
      menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    });
  });

  // Close mobile menu on outside click
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (!header.contains(e.target) && mainNav.classList.contains('header__nav--open')) {
      mainNav.classList.remove('header__nav--open');
      menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    }
  });

  // ── FEATURED PRODUCTS CAROUSEL ────────────
  var track = document.getElementById('featuredTrack');
  var prevBtn = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
  var nextBtn = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
  var scrollAmount = 280; // card width + gap

  function updateArrows() {
    var tolerance = 4;
    var atStart = track.scrollLeft <= tolerance;
    var atEnd = track.scrollLeft + track.clientWidth >= track.scrollWidth - tolerance;
    prevBtn.disabled = atStart;
    nextBtn.disabled = atEnd;
  }

  prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    track.scrollBy({ left: -scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    track.scrollBy({ left: scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  track.addEventListener('scroll', updateArrows, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', updateArrows, { passive: true });
  updateArrows();

  // Keyboard navigation for carousel
  track.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
      e.preventDefault();
      track.scrollBy({ left: -scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
      e.preventDefault();
      track.scrollBy({ left: scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  });

  // ── STORE LOCATOR ─────────────────────────
  var locatorForm = document.getElementById('locatorForm');
  var locatorResults = document.getElementById('locatorResults');
  var locatorEmpty = document.getElementById('locatorEmpty');
  var zipInput = document.getElementById('zipInput');

  locatorForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var zip = zipInput.value.trim();

    // Hide previous state
    locatorResults.classList.remove('locator__results--visible');
    locatorEmpty.classList.remove('locator__empty--visible');

    if (!zip || !/^\d{5}$/.test(zip)) {
      locatorEmpty.textContent = 'Please enter a valid 5-digit zip code.';
      locatorEmpty.classList.add('locator__empty--visible');
      zipInput.focus();
      return;
    }

    // Simulate network delay then show results
    var btn = document.getElementById('locatorBtn');
    var originalText = btn.textContent;
    btn.textContent = 'Searching...';
    btn.disabled = true;

    setTimeout(function() {
      btn.textContent = originalText;
      btn.disabled = false;
      locatorResults.classList.add('locator__results--visible');
      locatorResults.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
    }, 500);
  });

  // ── NEWSLETTER ────────────────────────────
  var newsletterForm = document.getElementById('newsletterForm');
  var newsletterConfirm = document.getElementById('newsletterConfirm');
  var emailInput = document.getElementById('emailInput');

  newsletterForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var email = emailInput.value.trim();

    if (!email || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
      emailInput.focus();
      return;
    }

    newsletterConfirm.classList.add('newsletter__confirmation--visible');
    newsletterForm.reset();
  });

  // ── SMOOTH SCROLL FOR ANCHOR LINKS ────────
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(function(anchor) {
    anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      var target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
      if (target) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var headerHeight = header.offsetHeight;
        var targetPosition = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - headerHeight;
        window.scrollTo({ top: targetPosition, behavior: 'smooth' });
      }
    });
  });

})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
